Package neqsim.process.safety.selfheating

Enum Class SelfHeatingGeometry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SelfHeatingGeometry>
neqsim.process.safety.selfheating.SelfHeatingGeometry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SelfHeatingGeometry>, Constable
public enum SelfHeatingGeometry extends Enum<SelfHeatingGeometry>
Body shapes supported by the Frank-Kamenetskii steady-state criticality analysis.

Each shape carries its critical Frank-Kamenetskii parameter deltaCrit, the value of the dimensionless criticality parameter above which no steady-state temperature profile exists and the body must self-ignite. The characteristic dimension r to which deltaCrit refers differs by shape and is given by getDimensionDescription().

The one-dimensional shapes additionally carry the Laplacian shape factor j used by SelfHeatingInductionSolver, where the radial Laplacian is d2T/dr2 + (j / r) * dT/dr with j = 0 for a slab, 1 for a cylinder and 2 for a sphere. Shapes that are not one-dimensional can still be used for steady-state criticality but not for transient induction.
